PLAYER · PRIVACY
Metadata settings
Optional movie and show details. Your local library and playback work without an internet connection.

When enabled, Player looks up titles as their catalogue cards appear and details you open. Work is limited to the foreground and stops as cards leave view. Only a normalized title, year when known, and movie/show type are sent. Unclear matches are never guessed.
Allow TMDB metadata

When enabled, Player sends only normalized titles, year when known and movie/show type directly to api.themoviedb.org, then fetches artwork from image.tmdb.org. TMDB also receives your network IP address and Player’s public app credential.
Your videos, subtitles, folder names, file paths and original filenames stay on your device. Disabling metadata keeps your local library available.
Player’s shared TMDB access is included in this build. It is a public app credential and can be extracted from the APK. Requests start only after you allow metadata.
Shared TMDB access is not included in this build yet. You do not need your own key; your library and playback continue to work offline.
This install has an older locally saved TMDB token. Its previous consent can remain active until you turn metadata off. You can also remove that saved token below.

OPTIONAL ONLINE DETAILS

With metadata enabled, Player can look up a title when its card appears in the foreground catalogue, or when you open its details. Only the normalized title, year when known, and movie/show type are sent. Your filename, folder, SAF identity, subtitles and video are not sent.
